item.title: Asian stocks track Wall St higher after US job losses ease rate fears
item.author: AFP Englischsprachiger Basisdienst
item.description: But he added: "The report reduces the case that the labour market is adding inflation pressures, but it does not provide a clean green light for a dovish pivot. And DWS chief US economist Christian Scherrmann said: "The report sent a clear dovish message to central bankers. A simultaneous decrease in labor demand and supply usually signals a slowdown in economic activity."
